title: Forbidden Grounds Deep Within · The Prisoner Appears
next_chapter_hook: "Just when Chen Ji thought he had seen through this chess game, the final words of that figure pierced his heart like an ice awl—'The fate you believe in is nothing but a speck of dust on the Heavenly Dao.'"

text.content: The moment the voice fell, Ye Qing's voice seemed to still echo in the cold wind of the forbidden grounds. Chen Ji felt the ground beneath his feet shudder violently, and the void before his eyes was torn open by some force. From the dark rift emanated a light that did not belong to this world, carrying an aura of ancient primordial chaos. A being that had slumbered for a thousand years in the depths of the Holy Sect had responded to their alliance in this manner.

dialogue.content: "Finally... someone has come." The voice did not come from the rift, but resonated directly in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea—ancient and weary, as if it had traversed endless years.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The fragment in his Mental Sea—the first page of the Tianji Record—was vibrating violently on its own, and the protective rune formed from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flashed frantically, as if sensing something extremely dangerous. He下意识地后退半步，右手已quietly掐出法诀，体内spiritual energy如临大敌般涌动。然而那股imposing并没有攻击性，反而带着一种说不清道不明的……熟悉感。

In the rift, a vague figure slowly coalesced. It was a humanoid silhouette, yet surrounded by countless tiny temporal cracks, each rift silently devouring the surrounding light and vitality. His features had been worn away by time and imprisonment until they were almost indistinguishable, save for those eyes—deep as an abyss, reflecting countless visions of stars collapsing and being reborn.

dialogue.content: "Descendant of Chen Xuan..." The figure's gaze fell upon where the fragment flickered on Chen Ji's chest, and his voice carried an inexplicable sigh of emotion, "No, you have walked further than he did then, yet also fallen deeper."

text.content: Chen Xuan. These two characters exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's heart. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned this name, yet being casually uttered by this being imprisoned for a thousand years caused an overwhelming surge in his heart. He took a deep breath, suppressing that turmoil, his face assuming its usual calmness and detachment, only the faint tremor in his fingertips betraying the waves within.

"Does the honored one know my Chen family's ancestor?" Chen Ji's voice was steady without a trace of fluctuation, "Imprisoned here for a thousand years, yet still knowledgeable of outside affairs—who exactly are you, honored one?"

dialogue.content: "Who exactly am I?" The figure actually let out a hoarse laugh, full of self-mockery and desolation, "I am the sinner imprisoned by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the rebel who attempted to pry into Heavenly Secrets, and also... one of your bloodline sources."

text.content: Bloodline source. Chen Ji's mind buzzed. He had never heard of any ancestor of the Chen family being a being of such caliber, yet the aura emanating from that figure made it impossible to refute—那种源自灵魂深处的共鸣，绝非普通的血脉关系所能解释。The Tianji Record fragment vibrated again, and Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently sounded: "Be careful, this person has connections to the Eye of Heavenly Dao!"

choice.prompt: Facing this mysterious existence claiming to be a bloodline source, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Probe the Truth of One's Origins
choices.description: Since the other party proactively mentioned Chen Xuan and bloodline connections, might as well follow this thread to probe deeper, to see if more secrets about the Chen family and the Tianji Record's origins can be extracted.
choices.visible_cost: May Expose One's Own Cognitive Blind Spots
choices.risk_hint: The other party is extremely scheming and may take the opportunity to implant false information

dialogue.content: "Bloodline source?" Chen Ji slightly raised an eyebrow, his tone carrying appropriate doubt and curiosity, "Honored one, imprisoned for a thousand years, yet well-versed in my Chen family's descendants. I merely wonder—what does this 'connection' mean exactly?"

text.content: His voice was unhurried, neither appearing overly eager nor deliberately evading, as if truly just chatting with an unseen elder. Ye Qing secretly broke a sweat nearby—thistrash younger brother's composure before this old fox was truly unfathomable.

choices.text: Directly Inquire About the Tianji Record
choices.description: Since the other party mentioned the Tianji Record and Chen Xuan, might as well point directly to the core, asking about the Tianji Record's true origins and how to remove its shackles, testing the depth of their sincerity.
choices.visible_cost: May Touch Upon Taboos and Cause Unknown Consequences
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Leads on Removing the Tianji Record's Shackles
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record involves Heavenly Dao secrets; forcibly pursuing may bring disaster upon oneself

dialogue.content: "Since the honored one knows about the Tianji Record and Chen Xuan, you surely also understand its current shackles." Chen Ji's gaze hardened, Spiritual Energy silently gathering at his fingertips, "I don't have much time—honored one, speak plainly."

text.content: He had secretly mobilized the Tianji Record's power,纳入推演将接下来三时辰的关键变数尽数。然而那身影周围的时间线竟是完全模糊的——仿佛被什么力量彻底遮蔽。This anomalous phenomenon set alarm bells ringing in Chen Ji's heart.

choices.description: Maintain thetrash persona, show weakness to probe the other party's intentions, to determine whether this mysterious existence is friend or foe, before deciding the next strategy.
choices.visible_cost: May Be Seen as Weak and Easily Bullied
choices.visible_reward: Gauge the Other Party's True Attitude
choices.risk_hint: The other party is extremely scheming; may turn the tables

dialogue.content: "Please don't blame me, honored one." Chen Ji suddenly stepped back, posture extremely humble, "This junior is merely a servant in the Tianqing Sect, of humble origins—how dare I claim any blood connection with the honored one? Only, I wonder why the honored one summoned this junior here?"

text.content: Ye Qing watched with slightly furrowed brows. Thistrash younger brother's acting was truly top-notch—that perfectly measured fear and reverence would make anyone truly believe he was a harmless little servant. Yet she clearly remembered—the Spiritual Energy condensed at his fingertips just now was not at all the caliber of atrash.

dialogue.content: That figure seemed unsurprised by any of Chen Ji's reactions. He slowly raised one hand, and the temporal rifts around him abruptly contracted, an indescribable force enveloping Chen Ji entirely. "That shackle on you—it devours ten years of your lifespan each time you use it, does it not?" His voice was calm to the point of cruelty, "The Tianji Record never gives freely; the interest it collects is your very possibility of survival."

text.content: Chen Ji's expression slightly changed. This secret he had told no one—not even Mo Xiansheng, who only believed it consumed Heavenly Fate Value, never suspecting the lifespan level. Yet the figure's next words made Chen Ji truly feel a bone-deep chill.

dialogue.content: "I can remove it." Four words, casually spoken, yet weighing like a thousand pounds. That figure's gaze pierced through layers of mist,直视陈机灵魂深处，"Not only that, I can tell you your true origins—about the Chen family, about the Tianji Record's origins, and... the true nature of the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

choice.prompt: Faced with this proposal sufficient to change destiny, how will Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Since the other party can see through the shackle's nature, they may truly have a method of removal. Accept first, then seek flaws in the process—initiative must remain in one's own hands.
choices.visible_cost: May Fall Into the Other Party's Control
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Possibility of Removing the Shackles
choices.risk_hint: A thousand-year prisoner must have ulterior motives; accepting may fall right into their scheme

dialogue.content: "And the conditions?" Chen Ji did not immediately refuse, instead直视那双映照星辰的眼睛，"The honored one wouldn't help me for nothing—what benefit is the Tianji Record's shackle to the honored one?"

text.content: His mind raced rapidly. If what the other party said was true, this was indeed a rare opportunity; but if it was a trap... A cold glint flickered in Chen Ji's eyes—then let the other party first taste the countermeasure he had carefully arranged. Having used thetrash title for so long, there must be some life-preserving means.

choices.description: The bloodline source claim is too astonishing; demand the other party prove their words first. A true ally won't mind being verified—this is reasonable probing.
choices.visible_cost: May Anger the Other Party and Lose the Opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Verify the Authenticity of the Information
choices.risk_hint: If the other party truly has sincerity, they won't mind; anyone with scheming would cooperate

dialogue.content: "Please don't blame this junior for being suspicious." Chen Ji clasped his hands in salute, posture respectful yet tone firm, "The bloodline claim is too astonishing—words alone won't suffice. If the honored one truly wishes to support a descendant, there should be some token or proof."

text.content: Ye Qing secretly nodded nearby. Thistrash younger brother was indeed meticulous in every detail, facing such a terrifying existence yet still able to maintain clear judgment. If it were someone else, they would have long lost their senses.

dialogue.content: That figure fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a long sigh. "You truly are like him." His voice carried more gentleness, "Chen Xuan was equally suspicious back then—despite their blood connection, he had to see verification with his own eyes before believing." With that, the finger he raised drew a gentle arc, and a beam of light sank into Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, Chen Ji saw a blurry scene—a vast ancient altar, a young man entrusting a newborn infant to an elderly figure.

text.content: Though the scene was blurry, the young man's outline... bore a seventy percent resemblance to the already-vague faces of his parents in Chen Ji's memory. Chen Ji's heart clenched violently, a never-before-felt emotion churning in his chest. He wanted to see more details, to see where the altar was, to see who the elder was—yet the scene abruptly shattered, leaving only an aged, weary voice echoing in his ear: "Child... find her... she is at..."

Chen Ji shuddered violently. Find her? Chen Nian! His missing sister for years! All these years he had strategized across the world, calculated every heart,唯独对妹妹的下落始终一筹莫展——天机录对她相关的预见总是模糊不清，仿佛被什么力量刻意屏蔽。Yet now, that figure could actually show him clues about her?

dialogue.content: "Saw it?" That figure's voice remained calm, yet carried a hint of playfulness, "Your sister Chen Nian is the perfect vessel for the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. The Holy Sect has hidden her well, but I know where she is." He paused, "The question is—what price are you willing to pay?"

choice.prompt: When sister Chen Nian is involved, how will Chen Ji respond to this final question?

choices.description: His sister is his only weakness; any price for her is worth it. But state it plainly—the deal that crosses his bottom line, he'd rather not make.
choices.risk_hint: The other party already knows the weakness; subsequent negotiations will be passive

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long time. When he spoke again, there was less scheming in his voice, more rare sincerity: "As long as she returns safely, I can pay any price—except betraying those I acknowledge."

text.content: Ye Qing was stunned. She had never seen such an expression in Chen Ji's eyes—not that of a strategist who calculated flawlessly, but of an elder brother willing to walk through fire for family. At this moment, she suddenly felt that choosing to ally with this person might have been one of the most correct decisions of her life.

choices.description: The more it involves weaknesses, the less one should show fear. On the surface cooperate, actually secretly probe how much the other party truly knows, set up a counter-trap.
choices.visible_cost: May Enrage the Other Party and Miss the Opportunity
choices.risk_hint: The other party is extremely scheming; counter-probing may backfire

dialogue.content: "Price?" Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying his usual hint of mockery, "Honored one underestimates Chen Ji. Having played the game for so many years, what kind of threat haven't I seen?" His tone shifted sharply, "倒是前辈，被囚千年好不容易遇到个能传话的，总不会只是想跟我做买卖这么简单吧？"

text.content: The temporal rifts around that figure momentarily stagnated, clearly not expecting such a reaction. Chen Ji keenly caught this trace of abnormality,心底sneered——果然，这老狐狸急着脱困，真正的交易砝码，恐怕比表面看起来要重得多。

dialogue.content: That figure suddenly fell silent. The temporal rifts around him began to tremble violently, as if some force was trying to drag him back into his cage. He raised his head to look beyond the forbidden grounds, his gaze flickering with fear and unwillingness.

"Time is running out." His voice suddenly became urgent, "Chen Ji, remember my words—the Eye of Heavenly Dao is never your enemy; it is the chessboard of this game! And you and I, we are merely pieces on its board!" He abruptly raised his hand, and a brilliant light shot toward Chen Ji, "This is the final gift I can give you. The method to remove the shackles lies in a place you have never set foot—the seventh level of Kunlun Ruins."

text.content: Chen Ji wished to pursue questioning, yet the figure had already begun to fade. His voice grew more distant, yet each word remained clear as if by his ear: "Find her... before it discovers... remember, the true complete form of the Tianji Record is not within your body, but in..." The words cut off abruptly, the temporal rift collapsed with a thunderous roar, as if it had never existed.

The forbidden grounds returned to dead silence. Ye Qing supported Chen Ji,发现他浑身已被冷汗浸透。After that beam of light entered his body, the Tianji Record fragment on his chest actually displayed a line of ancient text never seen before—coordinates to the location of the key to remove the shackles, and a direction he had never imagined. The seventh level of Kunlun Ruins. That forbidden land even the three major sects regarded as a death zone，竟藏着改变他命运的答案？

Chen Ji slowly clenched his fist, his knuckles white. His sister is in the depths of the Holy Sect, the method to remove the shackles is in the seventh level of Kunlun Ruins, and behind all this is the Eye of Heavenly Dao that even this thousand-year prisoner revered. He raised his head to gaze at the crescent moon obscured by dark clouds above the forbidden grounds, his lips suddenly curving into a cold smile. Having played the game across the world for so many years, he thought he had seen through most of the chess positions. Now it seems—the true chessboard is only beginning to reveal its outline.

"The seventh level of Kunlun Ruins..." Chen Ji murmuredwhispered, his eyes flickering with dangerous light, "看来这盘棋，是时候再掀几块底牌了。" He turned to look at Ye Qing, his voice recovering its usual calmness, "Saintess, congratulations on your imminent witnessing of atrash的崛起之路——from today, our alliance officially takes effect."
